hero.h1: Directive 8020 Co-op | Local Players, Online Play & Platforms
hero.intro: Plan your group around the platform and mode you will actually use. An online feature on one store does not establish the same capability on every version.

sections.heading: What the current platform pages list

rows: Confirm mode and group setup in the installed version
1–5 players; up to five online players
PlayStation Plus is required for online play
Check the current Xbox page separately for online features

sections.heading: Shared screen is not a crossplay promise

blocks.text: Steam combines shared-screen and split-screen co-op under one category. That category alone does not establish simultaneous split-screen play. Likewise, online co-op does not prove cross-platform matchmaking or a free friend pass.

items: Check the current page for every participant’s platform.
Update the game and confirm the intended mode appears in your version.
Review purchase, account and subscription requirements before inviting friends.
Use the actual on-screen controls for assigning characters and starting the session.

blocks.text: Launch-era copy described online play as a future update. Current Steam and PlayStation listings now advertise online capability. Use current platform information instead of treating an old launch promise as today’s availability. This guide does not infer unsupported Xbox online features.
